verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a sandbox, test-mode environment, or test API keys isolated from production data. The free web test-drive tool, the auth-check endpoint, MCP check_access, free x402 quotes and per-agent API keys are adjacent conveniences or production-side controls, not an isolated sandbox. A sandbox is a fair axis for a transcription API, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
